title: How well are open sourced AI-generated image detection models out-of-the-box: A comprehensive benchmark study
abstract: arXiv:2602.07814v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As AI-generated images proliferate across digital platforms, reliable detection methods have become critical for combating misinformation and maintaining content authenticity. While numerous deepfake detection methods have been proposed, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate fine-tuned models, leaving a critical gap in understanding out-of-the-box performance -- the most common deployment scenario for practitioners. We present the first comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art detection methods, comprising 23 pretrained detector variants (due to multiple released versions of certain detectors), across 12 diverse datasets, comprising 2.6~million image samples spanning 291 unique generators including modern diffusion models. Our systematic analysis reveals striking findings: (1)~no universal winner exists, with detector rankings exhibiting substantial instability (Spearman~$\rho$: 0.01 -- 0.87 across dataset

translated_title: 开源AI生成图像检测模型的开箱即用性能究竟如何：一项全面的基准研究
translated_abstract: 随着AI生成图像在数字平台上的大量涌现，可靠的检测方法对于打击虚假信息和维护内容真实性已变得至关重要。尽管已有众多深度伪造检测方法被提出，但现有基准主要评估经过微调的模型，在理解开箱即用性能方面存在关键空白——而这正是从业者最常见的部署场景。我们首次对16种最先进的检测方法（由于部分检测器发布了多个版本，共计23个预训练检测器变体）在12个多样化数据集上进行了全面的零样本评估，涵盖260万张图像样本，涉及291个独特的图像生成器，包括现代扩散模型。我们的系统分析揭示了一些引人注目的发现：（1）不存在通用的赢家，检测器的排名表现出显著的不稳定性（Spearman ρ 在不同数据集间为0.01–0.87）。
tldr: 本研究首次对16种最先进的开源AI生成图像检测方法（共23个预训练变体）进行了全面零样本基准评估，涵盖12个数据集、260万张图像和291种生成器，发现不存在通用最优检测器，且各检测器在不同数据集间的排名表现出极大的不稳定性。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first comprehensive zero-shot benchmark evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art open-source AI-generated image detection methods (23 pretrained variants) across 12 datasets, 2.6 million images, and 291 generators, revealing that no universal winner exists and detector rankings exhibit substantial instability across datasets.
